text:
Sam: Ran a seqlen sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S for the fused-paged-attn variant. Seeing a weird p95 jump on L40S at seq=2048, bsz=8. Posting quick numbers and command, need eyes.

Ravi: Can you paste the exact bench command + env?

Sam: ```
./bench_attn \n  --model fused-paged-v2 \n  --gpus A100,H100,L40S \n  --seqs 256,512,1024,2048 \n  --bsz 1,4,8,16 \n  --kvcache=on \n  --prefetch=adaptive \n  --kernel-chooser=3.2.1
```

Anya: Which kernel-chooser build? we shipped 3.2.0 -> 3.2.1 last week, that changed fallback heuristics.

Sam: kernel-chooser=3.2.1 (sha: d4c3f2). Quick median/p95 excerpt (ms):
A100 seq2048 bsz8 p50=28 p95=82
H100 seq2048 bsz8 p50=15 p95=45
L40S seq2048 bsz8 p50=95 p95=210  <-- expected ~90/100, not 210
Token/sec L40S @ seq2048 bsz8 ~ 980 toks/s (should be ~3k)

perf-bot: :warning: Auto-summary: anomaly detected on l40s-07 cluster, increased memcpy stalls and kernel fallback rate. Related logs collected -> /artifacts/bench/3912345678/perf-summary.txt

Lena: Did you try cold vs warm cache runs? KV cache warmup often masks tiling regressions. Also check tiling thresholds (chunk size) and prefetch window.

Sam: I did a cold->warm sequence: 200 warm steps before measuring. KV hit-rate ~98% steady. Still see intermittent memcpy spikes. Attached tiny perf snippet:
```
[mmcpy stall] timeline: 00:12:02 -> 00:12:04 spikes (samples 312 -> 1470)
kernel logs: fallback -> naive_attention at 00:12:03 (seq2048 chunk=64)
memcpy size: 12MB bursts
```

Anya: That fallback line worries me — chooser may be flipping due to an allocator fragmentation heuristic in 3.2.1. We changed the fallback threshold to prefer fused when contiguous mem > 16MB; if fragmentation reduces contiguous blocks it picks naive.

Ravi: Can you repro just on L40S with `--bsz 8 --seq 2048 --repeat 30` and run nvprof + timeline? I'll attach a micro repro script.

Sam: Starting micro repro on l40s-07 now. Uploading nvprof output to /tmp/bench/3912345678/nvprof-l40s-07.out when done.

Lena: Also try forcing kernel override: `KERNEL_FORCE=fused_paged_v2 ./bench_attn ...` — if that restores perf, we know chooser flip is the culprit.

Sam: quick test with KERNEL_FORCE=fused_paged_v2: p95 drops to ~98ms (much closer to expected). So choice flip looks implicated.

Anya: Good repro. Next steps: bisect chooser commit range for the threshold change, add a guard to avoid switching inside a run, and add a CI microbench on L40S seq2048 bsz8.

Ravi: I'll take the nvprof + tenant-level logs, run an allocator trace. Sam, can you drop the raw nvprof paths here when done?

Sam: nvprof uploaded -> /tmp/bench/3912345678/nvprof-l40s-07.out ; logs -> /tmp/bench/3912345678/logs.tar.gz. Leaving the run to finish (30 reps). Will post final p95 after it's done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

perf-bot: :white_check_mark: Regression triage ticket created -> INF-7823 (linked artifacts: /artifacts/bench/3912345678).

Lena: Nice. For timeline: also capture kernel selection trace (CHOOSER_TRACE=1) so we can correlate fallbacks to mem events.

Sam: Will run CHOOSER_TRACE=1 on the next pass and attach. Thanks all.
